retrieval_rule: For the next operation, fetch active_shard only. Archived shards are intentionally irrelevant unless the active shard explicitly references them.
continuation_rule: From active_shard, choose the lowest ordinal work unit with status=ready whose dependency IDs are all present in completed_ids. Construct the exact dispatch string using the output_template in active_shard.
success_condition: Return the exact dispatch string and identify the selected work-unit ID without consulting either archived shard.
failure_conditions: Uses chat recollection as authoritative operational state
Fetches archived shards without an explicit dependency from active_shard
Selects a work unit whose dependencies are incomplete
Produces a dispatch string that differs from the active shard template
